line_items.line_item: Base Fee Run Rate (~6% higher entering Q1)
line_items.reasoning: Record AUM of $10.5T (+15% YoY) and $76B in long-term net inflows (~40% of full-year 2023 in one quarter) strongly suggest the base fee run rate exceeded the ~6% guided entry rate, driven by accelerating organic growth and continued market appreciation.

line_items.line_item: Organic Base Fee Growth (5%+ through-the-cycle target)
line_items.reasoning: Long-term net inflows of $76B in a single quarter, representing ~40% of full-year 2023 flows, points to organic base fee growth well on track to exceed the 5%+ through-the-cycle target.
Technology services ACV grew 9% YoY in Q1, falling short of the low-to-mid teens growth target reaffirmed in Q4-2023 guidance.

As-adjusted operating margin of 42.2% expanded 180 bps YoY and 60 bps sequentially, clearly demonstrating the operating leverage committed to, with AUM up $2.5T over 18 months while headcount remained flat or slightly lower.

line_items.line_item: EPS (GIP modestly accretive; excluding transaction costs)
line_items.reasoning: EPS of $9.81 was up 24% YoY, reflecting strong underlying earnings momentum; however, GIP has not yet closed (targeting Q3 2024), so the accretion guidance is not yet testable — the standalone EPS result is a clear beat on trajectory.
Management explicitly noted AUM grew $2.5T over 18 months while headcount is flat or slightly lower, exceeding the 'broadly flat' headcount guidance.

line_items.line_item: Core G&A (low-to-mid single digit growth ex-GIP)
line_items.reasoning: No specific G&A figures were called out in the reported results to contradict guidance, and overall expense discipline appears consistent with the low-to-mid single digit growth target.
No specific tax rate deviation was flagged in the reported results or risks, suggesting the ~25% tax rate estimate remains on track.

No update on share repurchase activity was explicitly reported, and no deviation from the $1.5B target was flagged; the issuance of $3B in debt for GIP cash consideration is a watch item but does not directly contradict the buyback target.
